versionHistory.description: Established capture sessions, confirmed media leases, callback-scoped native reads, ownership, permission, lifecycle, and stable failure semantics.
Adds native-only render attachments and a sanitized bounded thumbnail copy while preserving every Version 1 operation and state semantic.

Adds module-defined concrete platform render surfaces with actual mount, lifecycle gate, ownership, and revoke semantics while preserving every Version 1 and Version 2 operation, state, failure, lease, thumbnail, and handle semantic.

Adds bounded streaming export from active confirmed media to a caller-scoped native sink while preserving every Version 1 through Version 3 operation, state, render, thumbnail, lease, and handle semantic.

differences.description: A retryable denial and a settings-required denial are distinguished only when prior request history and current system prompt eligibility make that conclusion reliable.
Temporary media is stored under the application-private cache area selected by the module.
The module-defined MediaCaptureRenderView internally owns PreviewView, SurfaceProvider, photo content, and the video player surface; the native owner sees only the concrete outer surface.
A system denial that cannot present the authorization prompt again maps to permanently_denied; policy-managed denial maps to restricted.
Temporary media is stored under an application-private temporary or cache area selected by the module.
The independent MediaCaptureAppleRendering product exposes MediaCaptureRenderView while capture preview, photo content, and player layers remain module-owned internals.

privacy.description: Never log handles, paths, bytes, or embedded metadata.
Handles are registry keys only and never path input.
Sanitized thumbnail copies contain no EXIF block.
Sanitized thumbnail copies contain no original filename.
Thumbnail pixels are re-encoded or equivalently sanitized before result commit.
Thumbnail copies retain no metadata beyond explicit display result fields.
Media content, handles, paths, and identifiers never appear in a thumbnail cache key.
Thumbnail reads never return source bytes, paths, URIs, descriptors, or untyped platform values.
A module-defined render surface is a Native lifecycle resource, never media data or a serializable payload.
Render surfaces, backing targets, sources, renderers, and bindings never cross a Runtime boundary.
Source, renderer, player, layer, binding, and cleanup access remains private to the Native Module.
Render diagnostics contain only stable enum fields and redacted status; instances, generation, internal resources, SDK descriptions, paths, and raw exceptions are forbidden.
The export sink is a typed caller-scoped native capability and is never serialized or stored in the module registry.
Export request, result, failure, diagnostics, and sink contract contain no path, locator, descriptor, or platform storage object.
Export diagnostics expose only stable outcome IDs and bounded lengths, never handles, source metadata, sink details, operating-system errors, exception text, or content summaries.
